extracted.name: Slow Cooker Chicken Tikka Masala
extracted.description: This easy Slow Cooker Chicken Tikka Masala recipe is packed with flavor, but couldn't be easier to make with simple ingredients like tomato sauce, coconut milk, spices, and chicken.
ingredient_lines: 1/4 fresh jalapeño pepper (, optional, seeds removed, finely chopped )
4 cups Hot cooked basmati rice, for serving
instruction_lines: Mix sauce ingredients together in a bowl.
Place chicken thighs in slow cooker and season with salt and pepper. Pour sauce over chicken. Cook on LOW for 6-7 hours.
Shred chicken (discard any bones). Stir in coconut milk. Add cilantro. Serve over hot cooked basmati rice.
